title: Drum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- drum shell (red) -->
  <rect x='22' y='38' width='56' height='40' rx='4' fill='#d92b2b'/>
  <!-- shell shading stripes -->
  <rect x='22' y='38' width='8' height='40' fill='#b01e1e'/>
  <rect x='70' y='38' width='8' height='40' fill='#b01e1e'/>
  <!-- diagonal decorative bands -->
  <rect x='30' y='52' width='40' height='4' fill='#ffc93c' transform='rotate(0 50 54)'/>
  <rect x='30' y='66' width='40' height='4' fill='#ffc93c'/>
  <!-- bottom rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='28' ry='9' fill='#8a1414'/>
  <!-- top rim (light metal) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='28' ry='9' fill='#c9cfd8'/>
  <!-- drum head (cream) -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='37' rx='23' ry='7' fill='#fff3d6'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='35' rx='8' ry='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- tension lugs -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#e8edf3'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#e8edf3'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#e8edf3'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#e8edf3'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='72' r='2.5' fill='#e8edf3'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='72' r='2.5' fill='#e8edf3'/>
  <!-- drumsticks crossed above -->
  <g stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='28' y1='26' x2='58' y2='10' stroke='#e0a850' stroke-width='4'/>
    <line x1='72' y1='26' x2='42' y2='10' stroke='#e0a850' stroke-width='4'/>
  </g>
  <circle cx='58' cy='10' r='4' fill='#f7d9a0'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='10' r='4' fill='#f7d9a0'/>
  <!-- sparkle -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='24' r='1.5' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='22' r='1.5' fill='#ffe98a'/>
</svg>
